title: station-placement
description: Optional station placement intent/metadata; it does not identify a coordinate basis or establish epoch compatibility. metadata-only preserves the authored spatial snapshot and does not evaluate a trajectory. When stationPlacement is present, active evaluation is supported only for body-orbit and stellar-orbit paired with a trajectory of kind orbital-elements whose orbit.anchorBodyId exactly equals primaryBodyId. For compatibility, older station records without stationPlacement may still be evaluated from an orbital-elements trajectory and its exact anchor; absence of stationPlacement does not identify a placement kind. stationKeeping describes maintenance behavior and does not activate evaluation. lagrange-region (including L1-L5) and deep-space are valid placement kinds as metadata only; their dynamics/evaluation are not implemented. The placement kind itself is not evidence that the spatial position was measured or propagated.

kind.description: Declared placement kind. All four values are representable as metadata; only body-orbit and stellar-orbit currently have an active orbital evaluator.

activation.description: active is currently accepted only for body-orbit/stellar-orbit with an orbital-elements trajectory anchored to primaryBodyId.

provenance.description: Authored provenance text; the API does not independently verify source authority or evidence.
